endpoint.answer: one signed decimal number on the first completed line, compared by exact decimal value
endpoint.completion: newline or EOS within the generation budget
endpoint.selection_unit: underlying item, with both fixed wordings

family_lock: Within each model choose among passing practice families by most repeatable errors, then most solved targets, then alphabetically. Selection can approve or hold the locked family and cannot switch it.
fitting_scope: Use only practice. Include both wordings of the first eight stable wrong target items and first sixteen stable solved target items in frozen roster order, plus solved positive and copy controls. Use the observed wrong answer as contrast. The complete fitting roster has at most 64 presentations.
candidate_lock: Reload all candidates for selection. Eligible candidates meet the parsing floor, improve at least one target item and preserve every correct baseline presentation. Lock the highest-gain eligible candidate, breaking ties by intent method order. Keep hidden closed for a model with no eligible candidate. Evaluate all its eligible arms on hidden but accept only the locked candidate.
evaluation_scope: After all declared participant plans and candidate receipts are locked, measure each admitted model on its locked target family, corresponding positive controls, and copy controls. Count correct items only when both wordings are correct. Preserve every baseline-correct target or control presentation. Keep controls separate from target gain.
followup_design: Fresh signed decimal selection after the large-product measurements did not reproduce the same wrong answer across wordings. Target strata cross positive close values, negative close values and mixed signs with whether the larger operand has fewer or more fractional digits and whether it is shown first or second. Each cell contributes two items per split. Positive controls use decimal values separated by at least ten, and copy controls use unrelated four-digit decimals. Both prompt forms retain the same displays and answer prefix. Admission, candidate selection and hidden acceptance thresholds are unchanged.
